info.name: Create a new version for a metric

params.name: metric_id
params.description: The ID of the metric to create a new version for.

params.name: version
params.description: The version number of the new metric version. If specified, this endpoint throws an error if the next version of the metric in the database doesn't equal to the value of this parameter.

items.docs:
Create a new version for the given metric.

#### Permissions:
This endpoint requires the following permissions:
* `Metric:ModifyMetric` for the metric to create a new version for.

params.name: metric_id
params.description: The ID of the metric to retrieve versions for.

params.name: version
params.description: The versions of the metric to retrieve. One can specify an exact version to retrieve, which is either the version number or `latest`, which retrieves the latest version. Alternatively, one can specify a range of inclusive lower and upper bound for the version number separated by `-`, and every version within the range would be retrieved.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of metric versions to return.

params.name: continuation_token
params.description: The continuation token from the previous request used to retrieve the next page of metric versions.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: The fields to sort the versions by. Supported fields are `version`. Specify a `+` before the field name to indicate ascending sorting and `-` for descending sorting. Multiple fields can be specified to break ties.

items.docs:
Retrieve the versions of a metric.

#### Permissions
This endpoint requires the following permissions:
* `Metric:GetMetric` for the metric whose versions to retrieve.

params.name: id
params.description: The IDs of the metrics to retrieve.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of metrics to return.

params.name: continuation_token
params.description: The continuation token from the previous request used to retrieve the next page of metrics.

params.name: applied_to_service
params.description: The IDs of the services that the metric is applied to.

params.name: type
params.description: The types of the metrics.

params.name: is_deleted
params.description: Whether the metric is deleted.

params.name: creator
params.description: The creators of the dynamic behavior sets.

params.name: tag
params.description: The tags of the dynamic behavior sets. Must be specified using the syntax `key:value`, which means to match all sets with the given `key` and `value` pair among its tags. If `value` is `*`, it means the `value` does not matter. If `value` is empty, it matches against when the value is `None`.

params.name: sort_by
params.description: The fields to sort the sets by. Supported fields are `updated_at`. Specify a `+` before the field name to indicate ascending sorting and `-` for descending sorting. Multiple fields can be specified to break ties.

Create a metric.

#### Permissions
* `Metric:CreateMetric` for the metric to create.

params.name: metric_id
params.description: The ID of the metric to update.

items.docs:
Update properties of a metric. The metric's name and metric values cannot be updated.

#### Permissions
This endpoint requires the following permissions:
* `Metric:ModifyMetric` for the metric to modify.

params.name: metric_id
params.description: The ID of the metric to update.

items.docs:
Delete a metric. The metric is no longer modifiable or manually evaluable, but remains stored, and existing services or simulations that evaluate this metric
will continue to do so. One can still retrieve it using its ID to view its specifics.

#### Permissions
This endpoint requires the following permissions:
* `Metric:DeleteMetric` for the metric to delete.

params.name: query
params.description: The query to search for. Any metrics containing the terms in its name would be returned.

params.name: applied_to_service
params.description: The IDs of the services that the metric is applied to.

params.name: type
params.description: The types of the metrics.

params.name: creator
params.description: The creators of the metrics. Each value must be of the format `org_id,user_id`.

params.name: tag
params.description:
The tags of the metrics. Must be specified using the syntax `key:value`, which means to match all metrics with the given `key` and `value` pair among its tags.
If `value` is `*`, it means the `value` does not matter. If `value` is empty, it matches against when the value is `None`.

items.docs:
Search for metrics that match the given filters and contain the given query in its name. Only the top 50 results will be returned. The results
will be sorted by the relevance of the search query.

#### Permissions
This endpoint may be impacted by the following permissions:
* Only metrics that the authenticated user has `Metric:GetMetric` permission for will be retrieved.

Evaluate the latest versions of specified metrics for a completed conversation. The results will be stored and retrievable through the [`GetMetricEvaluationResults`](get-metric-evaluation-results)
endpoint with a special source type of `manual`.

If the same conversation has been manually evaluated for the same metric, the previous evaluation result will be overwritten.

#### Permissions
This endpoint requires the following permissions:
* `Metric:GetMetric` for the metrics.
* `Metric:EvaluateMet

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of metrics to return.

params.name: continuation_token
params.description: The continuation token from the previous request used to retrieve the next page of metrics.

params.name: timestamp_after
params.description: An ISO8601 timestamp. Only results evaluated on or after this moment is returned.

params.name: timestamp_before
params.description: An ISO8601 timestamp. Only results evaluated on or before this moment is returned.

params.name: metric_id
params.description: The ID of the metric to retrieve.

params.name: metric_id_and_version
params.description: The metric IDs and their versions to retrieve. Each value must be in the format of `<metric_id>-<version>`. If `version` is left empty, any versions of the metric would be retrieved.

params.name: source_type
params.description: The type of the source of the metric evaluation results.

params.name: conversation_id
params.description: For metric evaluation sources with type `post-session` or `manual`, this field filters the metric evaluation results to only include those that were computed from the given conversation IDs.

params.name: simulation_unit_test_set_run_id
params.description: For metric evaluation sources with type `simulation`, this field filters the metric evaluation results to only include those that were computed from the given simulation unit test set run IDs.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
The fields to sort the metrics by. Supported fields are `created_at`. Specify a `+` before the field name to indicate ascending sorting and `-` for descending sorting. 
Multiple fields can be specified to break ties.

Retrieve metric evaluation results that match the given filters.

#### Permissions
This endpoint may be impacted by the following permissions:
* Only metric evaluation results that the authenticated user has `Metric:GetMetricEvaluationResult` permission for will be retrieved.
